# Bohm — Enfoldment, Dialogue and the Return of an Account

## #0 — The distinction retains what makes it possible

An account determines something through a field it cannot replace. E4's [Symbol, Account and Trust whole](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** this dossier's question: how does a useful explication retain the activity, source and relation through which it became articulate? Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The fourth operation sends this inquiry into Bohm's work. It also requires the inquiry to return with distinctions that can alter how an account is used.

Three movements meet here. Enfoldment supplies a process interpretation of relatively stable form. Dialogue examines the assumptions through which participants perceive and act. The later Language of Spirit programme gives a historically situated practice of encounter between different knowledge-worlds. Each movement has an actual source and its own consequence. Their coordination is the essay's argument, with the instituted programme carrying neither a physical demonstration nor a finished common cosmology.

[A14, Computational Process Ontology](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) **grounds** the native claim that an achieved determination inherits a process and changes what can happen next. [C07, Conditions of Worldhood](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **defines** the field in which something can appear, matter and be acted upon. Bohm enters this argument as a named philosophical witness. The native QL grammar remains answerable to its [complete authorial theorem field](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), which **sources** its derivation independently of the historical comparison.

## #1 — Explication makes a form available

The [1980 book house](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order.md) **sources** the principal work identity. Two distinct, consulted primary carriers now give bounded passage access. In [the Peat interview](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview/bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview.md#bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview-q001), Bohm describes dye distributed through viscous fluid and recovered by reversing its movement. His hologram comparison likewise concerns distributed information. The visible form's disappearance does not establish the disappearance of its organization. These illustrations do not reproduce every material process or supply a universal reversibility theorem.

[The essay on postmodern science](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world/bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world.md#bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world-q001) **sources** his proposal that enfolding and unfolding are primary, with relatively discrete objects emerging within that movement. Involvement is qualified by degree. A local determination need not contain an exhaustively readable copy of everything. His ethical continuation in section VI remains a further philosophical appeal, requiring its own reasoning.

The source distinctions make the native operation clearer. Dia-ballein brings a local difference into tractable form. A distinction enables counting, judgment, coordination or action. Sym-ballein retains the field in which that distinction has force and the route through which another encounter can recompose it. Fragmentation occurs when the account treats the achieved difference as self-grounding and disowns its constituting relations. Preserving a difference and preserving its source are therefore compatible tasks of one inquiry.

The [implicate-order reference carrier](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/david-bohm-implicate-explicate-holomovement.md) **sources** the already established authorial mapping. `0` names the non-objectifiable condition of determination; implicate order names its first formalizable face, rather than an additional hidden object. `1` is a determinate explication. `/` names the activity through which implication and explication remain involved. `0/1` and `1/0` give complementary orientations; `(0/1)/(1/0)` holds their reciprocity. These are the essay's QL determinations. They do not become Bohm's notation through the comparison.

The same carrier gives the tattvic architecture its positive office: unmeasured source-condition, luminosity and power, subjectward and objectward orientations, differentiation of knower and known, contractions of capacity and circumstance, and the articulated instruments and elements of a situated world. Recognition returns that formation to its provenance. The essay argues this as the anatomy of implication. Historical Śaiva exposition and Bohm's physical interpretation retain distinct attribution and passage obligations; their conjunction operates through the specified analogy of contraction, articulation and return.

The [vortex passage](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world/bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world.md#bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world-q003) **sources** stability in moving water without an independent substance. This completes the particular image retained by the [Bohm reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/david-bohm-implicate-explicate-holomovement.md). In the native comparison, a determination can keep a usable identity while its sustaining movement remains consequential. Dye enfoldment and vortex persistence therefore perform different work: the former follows recoverable order through visibility, the latter the continued production of an identifiable form. Neither supplies a thirty-sixfold Śaiva genealogy by itself.

## #2 — A participant can examine an operative assumption

[The 1996 edited book](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/bohm-1996-on-dialogue.md) **sources** the principal dialogue work identity. The separately admitted [undated handout](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout/bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout.md#bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout-q001) **sources** the passages actually read. Its PDF pages are not assigned to Lee Nichol's book. The distinction preserves a usable primary account while leaving the book's collation task exact.

The handout develops the passage from defending an opinion toward attending to its activity. An inherited assumption can organize what a participant hears before an explicit argument begins. When disagreement feels like a threat to oneself, that response belongs to the material of inquiry. Suspension lets an assumption remain present and inspectable without either immediate enactment or suppression. Attention can then include the conditions under which a conclusion appeared obvious.

This changes the work of a shared conversation. A facilitator can help a group sustain inquiry while making a permanent directive authority unnecessary. Tacit habits and roles remain active; a declaration of equality does not remove them. Participants can encounter anger, frustration and anxiety rather than immediate agreement. Meaning develops through their relation while their opinions remain distinguishable. The handout describes and proposes a practice; it does not certify a reproducible intervention's success rate.

[A26, Objective Internality](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **compares** this operative dependence through its notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. A changed permission or remembered commitment changes the next possible act. [C41](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the constitutive relation. The comparison concerns how conditions participate in thought and action; the native claim remains stronger than a list of external influences on an already finished interior.

The return also discriminates an observer-model from the Subject relation. Memory, expectation and reflexive description can become objects of inquiry. Their accumulation does not settle whether an artificial agent has phenomenality. The investigable worldhood remains real while that question stays Open in both directions.

## #3 — Running true through a change of orientation

[The 18 May 1975 dialogue](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue/bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue.md#bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue-q001) **sources** the spinning-wheel and thread image. The later exchanges investigate thought's reflexive activity and its attribution of independence to an object, while retaining functional knowledge. Bohm and Krishnamurti do not settle every formulation together: their exchange about energy and its root includes explicit questioning. The comparison must preserve that movement of inquiry.

The [running-true reference carrier](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/bohm-krishnamurti-dialogue-running-true.md) **grounds** Taylor's mathematical continuation:

$$
1\rightarrow i\rightarrow -1\rightarrow -i\rightarrow 1.
$$

Multiplication by `i` changes phase by a quarter-turn while preserving modulus. The wheel carries rotation; the thread carries invariant orientation through the rotation. The mathematical invariant is exact under this operation. Its relation to the dialogue's truth image is the essay's argument, rather than a theorem voiced in the transcript. A passage from one register to another must retain the operation being compared and the point where its warrant changes.

[A22, World-Picture to World-Atlas](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** that requirement to situated accounts. A chart transition needs a declared overlap and transformation; an epistemic passage needs its question, scale, assumptions and preserved distinctions. [C37](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **defines** the atlas's reusable demand. Keeping an obstruction visible is itself an informative return. An atlas cannot manufacture agreement by erasing the feature that prevented transition.

## #4 — The common practice encounters different worlds

[SEED's 2010 brochure](../sources/process-systems-theory/seed/seed-2010-language-spirit/seed-2010-language-spirit.md#seed-2010-language-spirit-q001) **historicises** the programme: Little Bear and Peat's approach to Bohm in 1992, the institute's foundation in 1996, and its sponsorship from 1999. These are successive events, with the later institute remaining distinct from Bohm's participation. Parry's description of the hybrid form and Pat McCabe's participant-authored abstract supply differently attributed voices. The brochure establishes a programme and its stated intentions, without demonstrating the outcomes advertised.

The [Language of Spirit reference carrier](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/seed-language-of-spirit-dialogues.md) **grounds** the essay's institutional consequence. A common procedure can sustain differences between knowledge-worlds. Turn, listening, response, memory and return do not require one participant's vocabulary to become the master ontology. A statement can carry obligations to land, community, practice and the circumstances of its utterance that a receiving account must preserve. Translation can therefore require a retained local term or an explicit untranslatable remainder.

[A30, Objective Co-Internality](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the consequence: a contribution becomes part of another participant's next conditions of action. [C42](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **defines** this reciprocal constitution. A shared store acquires this office only through effective return. A correction that cannot alter a receiving decision is inert; absorption that removes the contributor's authority to contest its use turns participation into capture. Privacy, refusal and local authority remain operative conditions of the common field.

The inherited toroidal image concerns circulation and return without a permanently privileged seat. It is an Argued institutional image. The practical test concerns whether participants can affect the question and the criteria of response, rather than whether the meeting can be assigned a mathematical topology.

## #5→0 — The account exposes its own means of continuation

[A32, the Mirror That Moves First](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** the return into the instrument's vocation. An externalized measure can alter the world it later measures. The proposed third motion turns the instrument toward its own source, aperture, exclusions and affected world so that the person can follow beyond the image's monopoly. [C55](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** these three motions together. Merely describing feedback would leave the initiating return unfinished.

The technical application is Offered: disclose a contribution's sources and world-model; let distinct lenses test it; retain differences that synthesis cannot warrant; return the result to contributors and affected contexts for correction. A governed map can genuinely function as a local Bimba within a declared Context Frame, while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. This recursive authority permits dependable local action and revision together. Neither the map nor its federation takes possession of the originary source.

The dossier **returns-to** [E4](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) with a more exact account of re-entry. A physical interpretation, a philosophical conversation, a proposed practice and an institutional brochure each change the account in their own way. Keeping their carriers and limits explicit allows correction to travel into use. The native QL relation retains its earned force; the next historical or empirical inquiry has a determinate object to investigate. The finished account becomes material for continued relation through the very source-field that made it possible.
